plan.notes: Source: official Middlesex Community College 2025-2026 'ACADEMIC MAP 15 to FINISH' PDF for 'Computer Science Transfer — Associate in Science' (www.middlesex.edu/students/advising/downloads/maps/cs.pdf; www.middlesex.edu is MCC's official site — homepage confirms Bedford/Lowell MA addresses, MassEducate). TRUE credential per the map and the catalog program page (catalog.middlesex.mass.edu, 'Computer Science Transfer — Associate in Science — Bedford Campus - Day'; MassTransfer transfer degree). Hand-transcribed 2026-09-30 from the map's term-by-term sequence (raw transcript saved in scratch dir as source-map-transcript.txt). Credit math: printed semester totals 16 / 14 / 16 / 14 = 60 on the minimum path; the map prints Semester 4 as '14/15' because the math/science elective slot is '3/4' credits ('Three credits in MAT 250 – Discrete Math –or– MAT 295 – Linear Algebra –or– BIO 131 (4) –or– CHE 151 (4) –or– PHY 171 (4)'), so the pathway is 60 or 61 credits depending on the student's choice. Minimum 3 used for that slot (bunkerhill-as-computer-science precedent); choosing a 4-credit lab science yields a 61-credit pathway — total_credits = 60 documents the minimum. Caveats: (1) Placement notes from the map are documented here, not modeled as prereqs: students with no programming experience who have not placed into MAT 290 must take CSC 101 Intro to Computer Science before CSC 151; students placing below MAT 290 should take MAT 195 Precalculus in semester 1 and MAT 165 Trigonometry in semester 2. (2) The map publishes no per-course prerequisites, so all prereq fields are empty rather than invented; sequencing follows the map's milestone order. (3) Lab Science courses must form one sequence: PHY 171+172, CHE 151+152, or BIO 131+132 (map Helpful Hints) — modeled as two choice slots with that constraint in choice_note. (4) Map notes: register early for 200-level CSC courses; CSC 151, CSC 156, CSC 202, CSC 252, CSC 255 are often offered in the summer semester.
